branch.description: Only pipelines on this branch, like main. Default: all branches, so a failing feature branch turns the tile red.

projects.description: Project slugs, like gh/acme/api (GitHub), bb/acme/web (Bitbucket) or circleci/<org-id>/<project-id>.

token_command.description: A command that prints the token, e.g. [op, read, "op://dev/circleci/token"]. Used instead of token_env.

token_env.description: Variable holding a personal API token. Default CIRCLECI_TOKEN.

url.description: API address. Default https://circleci.com; for CircleCI server, your server.

items.title: Cache the pipeline graph between renders

entries.description: The latest CircleCI pipelines of your projects, with each one's commit, branch and workflow result: failed red, on hold yellow, passed green. The tile turns red while a project's newest pipeline is failing, on any branch unless `branch` is set (try `branch: main`). Click one to open it in the CircleCI app. Untested live: built from the API v2 docs and sample responses.
entries.name: CircleCI
